findings.reason: without a stated setter the evaluation cannot attach the figures it exists to measure, so §8 as sequenced runs and measures nothing.
findings.text: §8 presents each drawn figure "through §6's dispatch path", but §6 declares that `TaskNode.images` is set by "§4's figure review" and that this is "the only caller that sets it", and §4 is deferred pending a lead decision on the metered-lane exclusion (see §4's data-status and the c-s4-lane-design-and-hold comment); §8 therefore names no mechanism that attaches its figures, and a node dispatched to §8 would carry an empty images list

findings.reason: the sequencing section is the plan's order of work and now describes §1→§2→§3→§4, a path the plan no longer takes, so a reader dispatching by it orders the nodes wrongly and skips §6, §7 and §8.
findings.text: §5 (declared `done` in plan-section-declarations) still sequences the plan as "§3 gates §4" and speaks of "the four", while §3 is now declared `deferred` and §8 is introduced as its executable node, with §6 and §7 running before it

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the _document intro's reckon/_backends.py:1220 resolves to the codex dialect's `exec` argv composition (verified), and §8's internal references (§3's table, §6's dispatch path, §7's declared lane) resolve to sections that exist.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §8's done-when is measurable (a per-pair, per-format record of the lane's verbatim verdict on the bad and good figure) and declares an image-withheld negative control.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §8 writes its figures under docs/figures/figure-review-pairs/ and its verdicts under the run's report directory, both durable paths a later reader can open.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach §8's prose, the figure directory name, or the new comments.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §8's mechanism runs on §6's dispatch path but names no caller that sets a node's images, while §6 declares §4 (now deferred) the only caller that sets it, so the dispatch §8 relies on carries no figure.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §8 carries one goal, whether the lane discriminates five known pairs; the drawing of the figures is the instrument of that measure, not a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — no depends-on/informs/gates edge among the changed units is missing or misdirected; the single plan-informs edge to scoring-should-stop-a-promotion is the one an earlier review reported, and §4 is the only section that edge was raised about, which is unchanged.
